controversies.title: Ratable Base Balance & Budgetary Oversight (Paterson City)
controversies.entityInvolved: Paterson City Municipal Administration & Tax Assessor
controversies.summary: County seat with New Jersey's 3rd largest school district. Receives 84% State Aid under Abbott/SDA funding, but high municipal operations budget ($348M) results in an 18.72% tax-to-income burden.
controversies.investigationDetails: Annual review of municipal tax appeals and school district funding allocations under Passaic County Board of Taxation guidelines.
controversies.taxpayerImpact: Affects composite property tax millage and municipal equalized ratables.
